curved/arc lines forming a framing or repeated arc band

justification: Both are upright slabs bearing schematic, thin-outline incised motifs including arcs and horizontal banding, but that is a generic linear convention rather than a shared motif set. A shows a head-and-shoulders anthropomorphic form with concentric discs, hatched hair-like lines and stacked chest registers, whereas B shows a single large masted vessel with a hull and a row of arcs beneath, enclosed in an arched frame — no specific subject is shared.
